title: SEO & AI Marketing Intern
description:
***SEO \& AI Marketing Intern***

Experience: 0–1 Year / Graduates \- Fresher with strong practical SEO knowledge

Duration: 3 Months

Department: Marketing

***Role Summary***

We are looking for an SEO \& AI Marketing Intern who has **strong practical knowledge of SEO and wants to build expertise in AI\-driven search, AEO and GEO.**

The candidate should already understand end\-to\-end SEO activities and should be able to independently handle basic SEO work without requiring SEO training. Training will be provided on **AEO, GEO and AI\-powered search platforms.**

***Key Responsibilities***

* Conduct keyword research, competitor research and search intent analysis.
* Handle On\-Page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, URL structure and content optimization.
* Understand and support Technical SEO, including crawling, indexing, sitemap, robots.txt, broken links and basic website audits.
* Support Off\-Page SEO and link\-building activities.
* Conduct SEO audits and identify website/content improvement opportunities.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic and website performance.
* Use Google Search Console and GA4 to track and analyse SEO performance.
* Optimize existing content based on keywords, search intent and SEO best practices.
* Identify content gaps and suggest new topics, FAQs and landing\-page improvements.
* Research how users ask questions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews.
* Track brand and competitor visibility across AI\-generated answers.
* Assist with AEO/GEO activities, including prompt tracking, AI visibility analysis and answer\-focused content.
* Maintain SEO, keyword, competitor and AI visibility tracking sheets.
* Prepare simple weekly/monthly SEO and AI\-search performance reports.
* Document learnings, experiments and recommendations for improving organic and AI visibility.

***Must\-Have Skills***

Strong practical knowledge of:

* SEO fundamentals and end\-to\-end SEO process
* Keyword Research
* Search Intent Analysis
* On\-Page SEO
* Technical SEO basics
* Off\-Page SEO \& Link Building
* Competitor Analysis
* SEO Audits
* Content Optimization
* Keyword Ranking \& Performance Tracking
* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics / GA4

***Good to Have***

* Basic knowledge of Google Ads / SEM
* Basic understanding of HTML
* Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Ubersuggest or similar
* Basic understanding of content marketing
* Interest in AI tools and AI\-powered search
* AI / AEO / GEO Knowledge

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Job Title: Senior Social Media Manager**

**Experience Required**: 3\-4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| In\-Office  
**Work Location:** Arcadia Building, Office No. 1A, Ground Floor, N.C.P.A. Marg, Nariman Point, Mumbai – 400021

**Working Days \& Timings:** Monday to Friday: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM 1st, 3rd \& 5th Saturdays: Working

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and creative Senior Social Media Manager to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end social media activities for multiple brands, creating impactful strategies, and driving meaningful engagement across platforms. This role requires a strong understanding of digital trends, content planning, analytics, and brand communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and drive social media strategies that support the company’s branding and marketing goals
* Manage social media presence across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels
* Create and maintain monthly posting plans and content schedules
* Write strong, engaging captions, hooks, and call\-to\-actions tailored to each platform
* Work closely with graphic designers, video editors, and content teams to ensure creatives are delivered on time
* Track social media performance, analyse results, and share regular reporting insights
* Interact with the audience by replying to comments, messages, and mentions to build community engagement
* Ensure profiles remain updated and aligned with brand identity (bio, highlights, links, profile optimisation, etc.)
* Stay informed about platform changes, new trends, and content best practices
* Support marketing campaigns through content ideas, execution, and continuous improvement
* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure social media activities align with overall business objectives

**Skills \& Requirements**

* At least 3 years of practical experience managing social media accounts professionally
* Strong knowledge of content formats, platform behaviour, and algorithm trends
* Excellent writing and communication skills with a good sense of tone and storytelling
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and meet deadlines in a structured manner
* Experience in planning content, monitoring analytics, and preparing reports
* Working knowledge of social media tools such as Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or similar
* Basic understanding of paid campaigns and boosting posts is an advantage
* Strong planning skills with close attention to detail
* Degree in Marketing, Media, Communications, or related fields is preferred

**Key Competencies**

* Social media planning and strategy building
* Strong understanding of Instagram and Facebook content performance
* Content creation support (reels, carousels, captions, storytelling formats)
* Copywriting for social platforms
* Performance tracking and reporting using Meta tools
* Basic creative skills using Canva / Photoshop
* Scheduling and publishing content efficiently
* Spotting trends and adapting them for brand content
* Effective use of AI tools such as ChatGPT for content support

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Self\-motivated and proactive with a creative approach
* Someone who takes responsibility for deliverables and outcomes
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, collaborative office setup
* Strong multitasking, planning, and problem\-solving skills

**Why Work With Us**

* Work on multiple brands across different industries and categories
* Opportunity to take ownership and bring fresh ideas to execution
* Be part of a growing team that values learning, collaboration, and creativity

*The Impact Engine is hiring on behalf of The Social Journey, Mumbai.*

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you familiar with graphic designing software eg. Canva?
* Are you familiar with Meta Business Suite?
* Can you analyse Meta insights?
* Do you have your own device/laptop?
* Are you an immediate joiner ? What is your notice period
* Email ID and Phone No:
* Are you currently based near Nariman Point, or would you be willing to relocate closer to Nariman Point for this role?
* Mention your current location
* Do you have experience working in a marketing agency or any other agency? If yes, please mention how many clients you have handled simultaneously.

Experience:

* Social media management: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:

**Job Title:** AI Digital Marketing Executive

 **Job Location:** Hinjewadi, Pune (WFO)

 **Experience:** 2 to 5 Years

 **Shift:** 11\.00AM to 8\.00 PM IST **,** Monday to Friday

 **Qualification:** BE , MCA ,BCA

 **Job Description**

  

Futurism on behalf of his client is looking for AI Digital Marketing Executive having good experience with AI powered marketing, Paid Campaign, Social Media, Analytics

 **Job Responsibilities:**

  

AI\-Powered Marketing

  

* Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Jasper, Copy.ai, Midjourney, Canva AI, and other AI platforms to enhance marketing productivity.
  
* Develop AI\-generated content for websites, blogs, social media, email campaigns, and advertisements.
  
* Use AI tools for keyword research, competitor analysis, market research, and content optimization.
  
* Implement AI\-driven automation workflows to improve marketing operations.
  
* Monitor emerging AI trends and recommend innovative solutions for marketing growth.

  

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

  

* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis using AI and SEO tools.
  
* Optimize website content, landing pages, and blogs for search engines.
  
* Perform on\-page, off\-page, and technical SEO activities.
  
* Track website rankings, organic traffic, and SEO performance metrics.
  
* Create and execute content strategies to improve search visibility.

  

Paid Advertising (PPC)

  

* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, and YouTube).
  
* Create and manage Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram).
  
* Utilize AI tools to improve ad copy, audience targeting, and campaign performance.
  
* Monitor campaign KPIs including CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS.
  
* Generate performance reports and recommendations.

  

Content Marketing

  

* Create SEO\-friendly blogs, landing pages, website content, and marketing materials using AI tools.
  
* Develop content calendars and publishing schedules.
  
* Optimize content based on user intent and search trends.
  
* Ensure content aligns with brand guidelines and business objectives.

  

Social Media Marketing

  

* Manage company social media profiles and content strategies.
  
* Create engaging social media posts, graphics, and videos using AI tools.
  
* Schedule and monitor social media campaigns.
  
* Analyze engagement metrics and improve campaign performance.

  

Marketing Automation \& CRM

  

* Manage email marketing campaigns and automated workflows.
  
* Utilize platforms such as HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, or ActiveCampaign.
  
* Implement lead nurturing and customer retention strategies.
  
* Maintain CRM data and generate marketing reports.

  

Analytics \& Reporting

  

* Monitor website and campaign performance using:
  
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)
  
* Google Search Console
  
* Google Ads
  
* Meta Business Suite
  
* Looker Studio
  
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
  
* Analyze data and provide actionable insights for continuous improvement.

  

Website \& Conversion Optimization

  

* Monitor website performance and user experience.
  
* Conduct A/B testing on landing pages and campaigns.
  
* Optimize conversion rates and lead generation funnels.
  
* Coordinate with development and design teams for website improvements.

 **Skills Required:**

  

* AI Tools: ChatGPT, Gemini, Jasper, Midjourney, Canva AI, Perplexity
  
* SEO Tools: SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, GA4
  
* Ads Platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads (LinkedIn Ads preferred)
  
* Marketing Tools: HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Zapier
  
* Technical: Basic HTML/CSS, WordPress/Shopify, CRO \& UX knowledge

 **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

  

* Organic traffic \& keyword rankings
  
* ROAS, CPL, campaign conversions
  
* Content engagement \& lead generation
  
* Website conversion rate improvements
  
* AI\-driven efficiency \& automation impact

 **Preferred Candidate Profile**

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
  
* Passion for AI and emerging technologies.
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  
* Data\-driven mindset with strong attention to detail.
  
* Self\-motivated and eager to learn new marketing technologies.
